name: Pokémon Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Same trial/Kahuna structure as Sun/Moon but with USUM's changes: different Totems at Brooklet Hill (Araquanid), Wela Volcano Park (Alolan Marowak) and Hokulani Observatory (Togedemaru), an extra Poni trial (Totem Ribombee, Captain Mina's trial), and Molayne replacing Hala in the Elite Four. First trial uses the Ultra Sun Totem (Gumshoos); Ultra Moon uses Alolan Raticate (Lv 12) with an Alolan Rattata (Lv 11) ally. Unlike Sun/Moon, Kahuna Hapu is fought at Exeggutor Island AFTER the Poni Island trials. Ultra Necrozma is placed after the Elite Four per this pack's boss ordering, even though the story fight atop Megalo Tower actually happens before Mina's trial and Hapu's Grand Trial. In USUM, Kukui is not a pre-Champion boss; the team recorded is his Title Defense team (variant for a player who chose Rowlet). His highest-level Pokémon is Lycanroc (Lv 69), so the cap is 69 even though his starter Incineroar is Lv 68. Moves, abilities and items are intentionally left blank.
